title: Laut ke Ghar Aajao
body:
laut ke ghar aajao baba
aaj sakina hogayi tanha
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ye maahol hai kaisa
zulm ka hai andaaz niraala
kaash chacha aa jaata mera
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aao mujhe godhi mein uthaalo
baba mujhe seene se lagalo
khaak pe hai bechain sakina
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan bhi lele tashna dahani
ab nahi maangungi mai pani
ammu se ye keh ke khudara
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bhai ali akbar bhi khafa hai
mera chacha bhi rooth gaya hai
kaun mujhe ab dega dilaasa
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise apna jee behlaaun
ab tak yun hi ashk bahaun
kis ko pukarun kaun hai mera
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
phail rahe hai shaam ke saaye
chaane lage har soo andhiyare
baba dil ghabraata hai mera
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
ab ye sakina so nahi sakti
gham mein musalsal ro nahi sakti
mera bistar aap ka seena
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho meri gardan mein rasan hai
durron se sab zakhmi badan hai
chin gaye gohar jal gaya kurta
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalim ne maare hai tamache
kaan hai zakhmi soyun mai kaise
aao dekho haal hamara
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi ro ro ke sakina
mushkil hai ab mera jeena
aur na ab tadpao baba
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
aane mein ab dayr na karna
dekho kehna maan lo mera
baba mar jaayegi sakina
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
<<DIVIDER>>
bain rasheed us bibi ke sun kar
rote thay paiham abid e muztar
tha ye musalsal uska nauha
aajao baba
laut ke ghar aajao baba...
author: Rasheed Shaheedi
